subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw core publish an `agent:turn:transcript:save` internal hook with durable ACP transcript-save semantics?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but accepting a new hook event and awaited ACP save boundary sets a contract for hook authors and session-state timing that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Close Unsponsored Surface
options.body: Close this PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if OpenClaw wants this hook contract later.

options.title: Sponsor And Refresh
options.body: Keep the direction, require a rebase, current-head proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the event name and ordering semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Ask for a smaller diagnostic-only or plugin-owned surface if maintainers want observability without committing core lifecycle ordering semantics.

recommendation.title: Close Unsponsored Surface
recommendation.body: Close this PR now and invite a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if OpenClaw wants this hook contract later.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily whether the internal hooks surface should grow; steipete introduced that hook system and is a strong routing owner for the product/API contract.
